title: A pullback-closed generating subcategory presents arbitrary sieve sheaves
statement: Fix a universe $u$. Let $C,E$ be $u$-small categories, let $J$ be an arbitrary Grothendieck topology of covering sieves on $C$ [def-weil-pbc-topos], and let $F:E\to\operatorname{Sh}(C,J;\operatorname{Type}_u)$ be fully faithful. Suppose for every $U\in C$ some $F(A)$ is isomorphic to the sheafification of the representable at $U$ [lem-trf-sieve-set-sheafification-exists]. Suppose also that for every cospan $A\to T\leftarrow B$ in $E$ there exist $P\in E$ and arrows $P\to A$, $P\to B$ whose image under $F$ is a pullback square. Then there is a precoverage $K$ on $E$ satisfying the covering-family site axioms [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and an equivalence $\operatorname{Sh}(C,J;\operatorname{Type}_u)\simeq\operatorname{Sh}(E,K^{\mathrm{Groth}};\operatorname{Type}_u)$. No pullbacks in $C$ are assumed.

proof.text: Define K to consist of presieves whose images under F jointly right-cancel maps to every sheaf. For an indexed family, form the sectionwise union of the images. Its sheaf closure includes into F(A). Joint right cancellation makes this inclusion epi; it is mono, hence an isomorphism. Conversely, local lifts and separatedness give joint right cancellation. Thus covering means that every section locally lifts along a member of the family. This works also for the empty family.

proof.text: Singleton isomorphisms and composites satisfy joint cancellation directly. For base change, choose the hypothesized ambient pullbacks for each covering arrow. Evaluation preserves these pullbacks, so a section and a local lift of its image determine a section of the pullback. The local-lifting criterion shows the pulled-back family covers. Faithfulness reflects the ambient pullback squares to E. This proves K.IsSiteForCoverings, including bind composition and actual covering-member pullbacks.

proof.text: The restricted nerve N(B)(A)=Hom(F(A),B) is a K-sheaf. A matching family of maps from a jointly epimorphic family gives matching sections on the covering sieve of local lifts of each section. Their values agree by the pairwise ambient pullbacks; glue in B. Uniqueness proves naturality and recovers a unique sheaf map F(A) to B. Pullbacks of generated sieves are covering by the same local-lifting test, so this proves the sheaf condition for K.toGrothendieck.

proof.text: Choose representatives of the sheafified representables using hrep, and transport arrows through the full faithful F to get v:C to E. The sheafification adjunction and Yoneda give natural bijections Hom(F(v(U)),B)=B(U). These identify restriction of N(B) along v with B.

source.place: Tag 03A1 (lemma-special-equivalence), site axioms and restricted-Yoneda comparison, extended to arbitrary sieve topologies by local representation and local equality as in the parent node.

proof.text: The section formula proves that v takes covering sieves to K-covering sieves. The maps from all sheafified representables to any F(A) form an epimorphic family, proving cover density. Local representation of sheafification sections proves local fullness; local equality proves local faithfulness.

proof.text: Let Jprime be the topology induced from K along v. Cover preservation gives J <= Jprime. The nerve is a K-sheaf and restricts naturally to any J-sheaf B, so every such B is a Jprime-sheaf. In particular the sheaf of J-closed sieves is a Jprime-sheaf; the closed-sieve classifier topology test gives Jprime <= J. Hence v is a dense subsite for J and K. Dense-subsite comparison makes restriction W an equivalence. Since N followed by W is naturally the identity, N is an equivalence. Choose K and the equivalence associated to N.

from.place: Generic source-localization input in the normal-cone specialization branch: replace the arbitrary small sieve-site presentation of a Grothendieck topos by a covering-family site before applying the good-site construction (Stacks 03CI). Subcategory comparison after the finite-limit closure.

lean.statement:
theorem sheafSubcategory_sievePresentation {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) {E : Type u} [SmallCategory E]
    (F : E ⥤ Sheaf J (Type u)) [F.Full] [F.Faithful]
    (hrep : ∀ U : C, ∃ A : E,
      Nonempty (F.obj A ≅ (presheafToSheaf J (Type u)).obj (yoneda.obj U)))
    (hpb : ∀ (A B T : E) (f : A ⟶ T) (g : B ⟶ T),
      ∃ (P : E) (p : P ⟶ A) (q : P ⟶ B),
        IsPullback (F.map p) (F.map q) (F.map f) (F.map g)) :
    ∃ K : Precoverage E, K.IsSiteForCoverings ∧
      Nonempty (Sheaf J (Type u) ≌ Sheaf K.toGrothendieck (Type u))
